changes.title: Sea and music
items: The music no longer cuts in and out: it plays straight through hitches and only crossfades
The sea round the island is a calm moonlit blue instead of a black void

changes.title: Everyone sleeps
items: Animals' legs no longer have a glowing outline: only their bodies catch the moonlight rim

Every creature can now lie down and sleep, eyes shut and breathing slowly: foxes and cats curl up, birds tuck their heads in, the snake coils, bugs press flat to the ground (ready for when the party's over)

changes.title: Treetop sigils
items: From the treetops you can see your animals' sigils: every leashed and happy creature near you shows its sigil floating over it above the canopy (happy ones a little dimmer), and the sigils you've put down show bigger up there too
